name: netmax
description: 14 network-diagnostic tools for AI coding agents — speed test, DNS ranking, bufferbloat, WiFi, jitter, packet loss, multi-stream download.
long_description: NetMax exposes a local-first network diagnostics engine to any MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, LM Studio, DSH). Tools cover speed testing, DNS resolver ranking, bufferbloat under load, packet loss, jitter, WiFi details, downloads, and session summaries. The engine is Python 3.10+ with curl; the server is a Node ESM stdio process.

tools.name: measure_speed
tools.description: Run a network speed test (download, upload, latency)

tools.name: dns_ranking
tools.description: Rank DNS resolvers by real query latency

tools.name: full_diagnostics
tools.description: Run the complete network diagnostic suite

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Benchmark download throughput for a URL

tools.name: session_info
tools.description: Show session info and server status
